title: Acquirer: Ariadne Australia Limited, Kings Parking; Target: Secure Parking

body_sections.Summary: Kings Parking Group (owned by Ariadne Australia Limited) and Secure Parking Group (owned by Auspark Holdings Pty Ltd) propose to enter into a joint venture agreement (proposed JVA) to combine their car parking operations in Australia.
body_sections.Market definition: The following markets are relevant: 1. separate regional markets based on local government areas for the supply of casual car parking to customers; 2. separate regional markets based on local government areas for the supply of permanent car parking to customers; and 3. separate state markets for the acquisition of car park management services and leasing of car park facilities.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On the basis of the information provided by the parties, the proposed JVA does not appear to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets for the following reasons: 1. the market concentration figures following the proposed JVA will not exceed the Commission's Merger Guidelines thresholds except for the Spring Hill area in Brisbane; 2. there a number of competitors to the merged entity, such as Wilsons Parking, Enacon and Care Park who may effectively constrain the exercise of market power by the merged entity; and 3. there appears to be significant countervailing power in the hands of building owners and customers.
